scope.description: TS-EC-12000-011 through -015 - the five eoRequestExport HYBRID scenarios previously BLOCKED on BLOCKER-EC-12000-002 - are now implemented for real and pass live against qa5, superseding their BLOCKED result in EXEC-EC-12000-001. BLOCKER-EC-12000-002 is resolved: the eoRequestExport endpoint, method and response were confirmed live (POST, dedicated API credentials ECORE_API_LOGIN_USERNAME/ECORE_API_KEY), and each scenario's asserted Media Type is confirmed via the UI audit trail (Document History's Submitted Paper Out event), never via the API response itself. This run also exercises a corrected transaction-document reveal mechanism in EcoreWorkspacePage (see VALIDATED comment on revealDocumentsOfSelectedTransaction) discovered while debugging an intermittent 'document row not found' failure, and a two-collection fixture design for TS-EC-12000-015 (its two eoRequestExport calls must target distinct documents - confirmed live that the application rejects a second export against a document its own transaction-level export already locked, with DOCUMENT_LOCK_ERROR).

scenarios.gherkinScenario: API mediaType=PrintToPaper at transaction level determines Media Type Paper
API mediaType=PrintToPaper at document level determines Media Type Paper
API mediaType=SaveAsElectronicFile at transaction level determines Media Type Electronic
API mediaType=SaveAsElectronicFile at document level determines Media Type Electronic
API call omitting mediaType entirely determines Media Type Electronic
